en.headline: Lo says HA hired over 3,100 nurses this year, up about 20 percent
en.dek: The health chief rejected claims that local graduates face mass unemployment, saying nearly 95 percent of applicants to the Hospital Authority were successful.
body: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said the Hospital Authority had hired more than 3,100 nurses this year, about 20 percent more than the more than 2,600 recruited last year. He was responding to claims that the authority was cutting hiring and that locally trained graduates were leaving school without jobs.

Lo said a figure of 5,000 nurses circulating in public discussion referred to enrolment, not this year's graduating class. Actual graduates from the various programmes numbered 4,083, of whom more than 3,500 registered as nurses. Of those, only a little more than 2,500 applied to the Hospital Authority.

Among applicants to the authority, the success rate was nearly 95 percent, he said. Others took jobs in private hospitals, clinics and other sectors. Lo also said the Hospital Authority does not hire non-locally trained psychiatric nurses, and that locally trained psychiatric nurses have strong employment prospects.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：醫管局今年聘逾3100名護士 按年增約兩成
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長反駁減聘及「畢業即失業」說法，指向醫管局求職的註冊護士錄取率近95%。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，醫院管理局今年已聘用逾3100名護士，較去年逾2600人增加約兩成。他回應近日有關醫管局減聘護士、本地畢業生「畢業即失業」的說法，指有關言論並不正確。
盧寵茂說，外界提到的5000人是入學人數，並非本屆畢業人數。各課程實際畢業生為4083人，當中逾3500人已註冊為護士，而向醫管局申請職位的只有二千五百多人。
他指，向醫管局求職的錄取率接近95%，其餘畢業生可投身私家醫院、診所及其他界別。他又說，醫管局並無聘用非本地培訓的精神科護士，本地培訓精神科護士就業機會充足。
